title: Adrenal Zona Fasciculata Nuclei of Gerbils Fed a High-Carbohydrate Diet: A Morphological and Textural Analysis
content: The adrenal cortex plays a critical role in the regulation of metabolic and stress responses through secretion of glucocorticoids, particularly cortisol. In this study, we investigated morphological and textural changes in the nuclei of adrenal fasciculata zone cells in gerbils submitted to a high-carbohydrate diet (high fructose and glucose diet) and their correlation with cell hyperactivity.
